faq.question: What does JSON repair do?
faq.answer: JSON repair takes invalid JSON and applies best-effort fixes so the result is valid, parseable JSON. In short, it helps you fix JSON that other tools reject. It addresses common problems such as trailing commas, single quotes, unquoted keys, missing closing brackets, comments, and Python or JavaScript constants.

faq.question: Can it fix invalid JSON?
faq.answer: It can fix invalid JSON when the structure can be recovered. It cannot invent missing data or guess an entirely wrong structure. If the input is too broken, the tool reports an error instead of returning a misleading result.

faq.question: Does it remove comments from JSON?
faq.answer: Yes. Single-line (//) and block (/* */) comments are stripped, because comments are not part of standard JSON. If you specifically need JSON with comments, use a JSONC tool instead.

faq.question: Does it change my data values?
faq.answer: Repair changes syntax, not your values. String contents, numbers, and structure are preserved. Constants such as Python True/False/None are mapped to their JSON equivalents true/false/null so the document becomes valid.

faq.question: How are single quotes and unquoted keys handled?
faq.answer: Single quotes are converted to double quotes, and unquoted object keys are wrapped in double quotes. Smart quotes are also normalized to straight quotes so the document parses.

faq.question: Can it handle Python or JavaScript constants?
faq.answer: Yes. Values such as True, False, None, NaN, and Infinity are converted to valid JSON values when they appear in the input. This is useful when pasting output from a Python or Node.js REPL.

faq.question: Is my JSON data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Repair, validation, and formatting run in your browser. Your JSON is not uploaded to a server and no account is required. Avoid pasting secrets such as passwords, tokens, or production credentials into any online tool.

faq.question: What if repair fails?
faq.answer: If the document cannot be recovered, the tool shows an error instead of producing partial output. Review the source for missing or duplicated structural characters, then try again.

faq.question: Is this a free JSON repair tool?
faq.answer: Yes. You can repair JSON, review the result, copy it, or download it without creating an account.

article.title: How to Repair Invalid JSON Online
article.content:
What Is JSON Repair?

JSON repair is the process of turning invalid JSON into valid, parseable JSON. Real-world JSON often breaks because of copy-paste from code, exported configuration, or REPL output. A JSON fixer applies best-effort corrections so the document can be parsed again.

Common JSON Errors This Tool Fixes

  • Trailing commas: a comma before a closing } or ] is removed.
  • Single quotes: strings written with single quotes are converted to double quotes.
  • Unquoted keys: object keys without quotes are wrapped in double quotes.
  • Missing brackets: unclosed { or [ are closed when the structure allows it.
  • Comments: // and /* */ comments are stripped.
  • Python and JS constants: True, False, None, NaN, and Infinity are mapped to valid JSON.

How to Repair Broken JSON

  1. Paste the broken JSON: include comments, single quotes, or trailing commas if present.
  2. Repair: the tool applies fixes and parses the result.
  3. Review: confirm the output is valid JSON and adjust the indent if needed.
  4. Copy or download: use the repaired document in your workflow.

Repair vs Format

Repair fixes syntax so the document becomes valid JSON. Formatting, by contrast, only changes indentation and spacing of JSON that is already valid. Use repair first; if you only need readable spacing on valid JSON, a formatter is enough.

Limits of JSON Repair

JSON syntax error fix is best-effort. It cannot invent missing data or recover a document whose structure is fundamentally wrong. If the input is too broken, the tool reports an error rather than returning a misleading result. After repair, validate important data with a JSON schema validator before using it in production.

Privacy

Repair runs entirely in your browser. Your JSON is not uploaded, and no account is required. Do not paste passwords, tokens, or production credentials into any online tool.

article.title: 如何在线修复无效的 JSON
article.content:
什么是 JSON 修复？

JSON 修复是把无效的 JSON 变成合法、可解析 JSON 的过程。现实中的 JSON 经常因为从代码里复制、导出的配置或交互式环境输出而损坏。JSON 修复工具会做最大努力的修正，让文档可以再次被解析。

本工具能修复的常见 JSON 错误

  • 尾随逗号：闭合 } 或 ] 前的逗号会被去掉。
  • 单引号：用单引号写的字符串会被转换成双引号。
  • 未加引号的键：没有引号的键会被包上双引号。
  • 缺失括号：在结构允许时会补上未闭合的 { 或 [。
  • 注释：// 与 /* */ 注释会被去掉。
  • Python 与 JS 常量：True、False、None、NaN、Infinity 会映射成合法的 JSON。

如何修复损坏的 JSON

  1. 粘贴损坏的 JSON：可以包含注释、单引号或尾随逗号。
  2. 修复：工具应用修复并解析结果。
  3. 查看：确认输出是合法 JSON，必要时调整缩进。
  4. 复制或下载：把修复后的文档用于你的工作流。

修复与格式化的区别

修复是把语法改对，让文档变成合法 JSON；而格式化只是给本来就合法的 JSON 调整缩进和空格。先修复；如果你只需要给合法 JSON 换个好看的间距，用格式化工具就够了。

JSON 修复的局限

json 语法错误修复是最大努力的，无法凭空补出缺失的数据，也恢复不了结构根本错误的文档。如果输入损坏过于严重，工具会报错而不是返回误导性的结果。修复之后，重要的数据建议再用 JSON Schema 校验器验证，再用于生产。

隐私

修复完全在你的浏览器中运行，JSON 不会被上传，也不需要账号。请不要在任何在线工具里粘贴密码、令牌或生产环境凭据。
